say:2:1041567101:1.text: How does one take care of a newborn tree?
say:2:1041567101:1.source_cn: 新生的树该怎么照顾呢。

say:3:1041567102:1.text: Well, it's the seed sibling of the Lucent Tree, and it's been blessed by Misarte. I assume it will grow fine.
say:3:1041567102:1.source_cn: 毕竟是流荧树的兄弟之树，有弥萨忒的伟力，应该不会有什么...

say:4:1041567103:1.text: Yes, but Sal'thorin is underground after all. Will the tree be alright with that?
say:4:1041567103:1.source_cn: 话是这么说，但毕竟萨洛克兰是地底，那还是一棵地面上的树。

say:5:1041567104:1.text: They're at their wits' end. They've never had to care for a plant like that before.
say:5:1041567104:1.source_cn: 原本的园丁们都束手无策，毕竟他们也没照顾过这种植物。

say:6:1041567105:1.text: We can throw a lot of men at the water problem, but sunlight and fresh air? Those aren't things you can force.
say:6:1041567105:1.source_cn: 降水姑且还能用人力弥补，但是光照和通风就没法保证了。

say:7:1041567106:1.text: Don't worry, Indris. The tree was a gift from Misarte. It will surely thrive like the Lucent Tree.
say:7:1041567106:1.source_cn: 不用担心，因度厄，作为弥萨忒的恩赐，它一定会像流荧树一...

say:8:1041567107:1.text: One can only pray to Misarte for her blessing.
say:8:1041567107:1.source_cn: 只能祈祷弥萨忒保佑吧。

say:9:1041567108:1.text: Oh, speaking of blessings, I heard the other day that there have been offerings placed in front of the tree.
say:9:1041567108:1.source_cn: 说到保佑，前些日子，听说已经有人在树前面摆祭品了。

say:10:1041567109:1.text: Ah, this happens in the Dark Forest as well.

say:11:1041567110:1.text: There are always people placing wreaths and fruit in front of the Deer Spirit statue at the Spirit Mound.
say:11:1041567110:1.source_cn: 在鹿灵圣丘，也会有人在鹿灵雕像前摆花环和食物。

say:12:1041567111:1.text: Lyca and Bryon often need to arrange for it to be cleaned up.
say:12:1041567111:1.source_cn: 莱卡和布莱恩经常需要安排人去清理。

say:13:1041567112:1.text: It would be fine if it was just flowers and fruit, but people in Sal'thorin have been throwing coins in front of the tree.
say:13:1041567112:1.source_cn: 如果只是花朵和食物倒也好办，萨洛克兰有人往树前面丢硬币。

say:14:1041567113:1.text: They say it's a ritual learned from the surface. If you toss a coin in the right spot, your wish will come true.
say:14:1041567113:1.source_cn: 说是从地面上学到的祭祀方式，丢一枚硬币就可以心愿成真。

say:15:1041567114:1.text: That's for wishing wells and fountains...
